name: PixelSnow-TS-TW
title: Pixel Snow
description: Tiny square snow flecks fall steadily through black space, larger and brighter close up and fading to specks in the distance. It adds a quiet winter drift to a dark section.
use: A dark seasonal or festive page wants a light snowfall without using images.
avoid: Delicate white specks nearly vanish on light backgrounds and behind busy content.
a11y: A canvas backdrop with no labels; the endless fall ignores reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A black stage is dusted with tiny white square flecks spread evenly at many sizes. Nearer flakes are bigger and brighter while distant ones shrink to single pixels, giving a sense of depth.
behaves: The flakes drift steadily downward with a slight sideways lean, tumbling at different speeds. The fall runs quietly from the moment it loads and never repeats.
customise: Colour, flake size, pixel resolution, speed, density, depth fade, brightness, flake shape and fall direction are props.
weight: heavy: A ray march of up to 128 steps per pixel for the snow field every frame.
demo: White square flakes falling on black at default density and speed.
polishWhy: Quiet, even snowfall with believable depth; flecks are tiny and barely read at gallery size.
